ccmcp Configuration Reference

All settings live in config.yaml at the project root. Environment variables
override file settings. The config file is gitignored; copy config.example.yaml
to get started.


qdrant.url
  URL of the Qdrant instance.
  Default: http://localhost:6333
  Env override: QDRANT_URL

qdrant.collection
  Name of the Qdrant collection for document chunks.
  Default: techdocs
  Env override: QDRANT_COLLECTION

qdrant.api_key
  API key for Qdrant Cloud. Leave empty for local instances.
  Env override: QDRANT_API_KEY


embedding.dense_model
  HuggingFace model identifier for dense embeddings.
  Default: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5

embedding.sparse_model
  Model identifier for sparse BM25 embeddings.
  Default: Qdrant/bm25

embedding.rotation_matrix
  Path to the orthogonal rotation matrix (.npy file).
  Generated once by: ccmcp setup


sources.filesystem.roots
  List of directory paths to scan and watch for document changes.
  Example: [~/projects/my-repo, ~/docs]

sources.filesystem.watch
  Enable live filesystem watching with polling observer.
  Default: true

sources.web.urls
  List of URLs to fetch and index.

sources.web.sitemaps
  List of sitemap URLs; all <loc> entries are fetched.


mcp.host
  Bind address for the SSE MCP server.
  Default: 127.0.0.1

mcp.port
  TCP port for the SSE MCP server.
  Default: 7700

mcp.result_limit
  Maximum results returned by qdrant_find.
  Default: 10


state.db_path
  Path to the SQLite state database tracking ingested sources.
  Default: ~/.local/share/ccmcp/state.db

state.artifact_ttl_days
  Days before agent artifacts are automatically removed.
  Default: 30
